function readA(x: { [k: `a${string}`]: number }, k: any) {
  const n: number = x[k];
  console.log(n);
}
readA({ a1: 1 }, "a1");

function readB(x: { [k: `b${string}`]: string }, k: any) {
  console.log(x[k]);
}
readB({ b1: "hi" }, "b1");

function both(x: { [k: `a${string}`]: number; [s: `b${string}`]: string }, k: any) {
  const v: never = x[k];
  console.log(v);
}
both({ a1: 1, b1: "s" }, "b1");

function write(x: { [k: `a${string}`]: number }, k: any) {
  x[k] = 2;
  console.log(x);
}
write({ a1: 1 }, "a2");
